notes: Every request is [cmd 7e][key][len LE16][payload]; replies are [status][data...].
expect_reply_hex is the whole reply and expect_reply_prefix_hex its first bytes, status included.
Unsolicited settled notices arrive as key 24 with [00][tag LE16]; do not match them as replies.
Only the master arm replies; both arms run every command.

Step 1 runs first after every boot: the first 0x7E command of a boot reads the breadcrumbs the previous boot left (256 bytes at 0x0209ce74 that the boot clear skips) and the status JSON reports them as boot and last_crash.

Key 25 replies [status][CRC-32 of the answering arm's canvas LE][eye]; the expected values are the right arm's, from tests/rv32/runtime_emulator_test.py --expected (only the master, the right arm, replies).

steps.title: Breadcrumbs from the previous boot
steps.look_for: Record boot and last_crash (they lead the JSON). boot is 1 when the record started fresh (first boot after this flash, or a power cycle cleared RAM) and grows by one after every reset that kept RAM. last_crash is null when the previous boot ended at rest; after a crash it names the lane (router, ui, pump), the stage it never left (router, dispatch, render, present, reply, tick), the command number seq, key, mode (first scene byte) and len, and open lists every unfinished lane as bits (1 router, 2 ui, 4 pump). Run this step again after any reboot during the suite.

steps.title: Identity
steps.look_for: Nothing changes on the glasses. Note which arm answered (arm, eye).

steps.title: Status before the lease
steps.look_for: Record heap_free and heap_largest (the lease now borrows a stock framebuffer for the canvas; the retained scene takes about 121 KB of heap and keeps 48 KB for the stock firmware) and panel_brightness (the level the restore step sends).

steps.title: Echo
steps.look_for: Reply repeats the payload.

steps.title: 1200-byte chunk checksum
steps.look_for: Length 1200 and the zlib CRC-32 of the payload: the multi-chunk transfer arrived intact.

steps.title: Acquire the display
steps.look_for: Both eyes go black: the stock UI is gone and stays gone. Reply byte 1 is the flush result (0 sent), byte 2 display on, byte 3 the answering arm's eye.

steps.title: Status while owned
steps.look_for: heap_free drops by only the 1.3 KB session: the canvas is a borrowed stock framebuffer. repins stays 0.

steps.title: Canvas checksum: black
steps.look_for: Nothing changes. The right eye's canvas is 75,600 zero bytes: the borrowed stock framebuffer was cleared.

steps.title: Demo geometry frame (mode 36)
steps.look_for: Both eyes: a rounded border at the panel edge, two diagonals, a row of eight filled circles from dark to bright across the middle and a large ring around the centre.

steps.title: Canvas checksum: demo frame
steps.look_for: Nothing changes. The right canvas matches the emulator's render of the demo frame.

steps.title: Retained scene with a glide
steps.look_for: Both eyes: rounded border, filled circle in the centre, a diagonal line, and a small box that slides from the top left to the top right over about 2 s. A settled notice (key 24, tag 03 00) follows the slide.

steps.title: Scene holds without auto-off
steps.look_for: The scene stays up for the whole 40 s on both eyes: no auto-off, no stock UI flashing through, no flicker.

steps.title: Canvas checksum: retained scene after 40 s
steps.look_for: Nothing changes. The settled retained scene is bit-exact after the hold: no stock code drew into the borrowed buffer.

steps.title: Per-eye objects
steps.look_for: Close each eye in turn: the left eye has a block at the bottom left, the right eye a block at the bottom right; neither eye sees the other's block. The geometry stays in both.

steps.title: Canvas checksum: per-eye objects
steps.look_for: Nothing changes. The right canvas holds the right-only block, not the left one.

steps.title: SHOW for the right eye only
steps.look_for: Right eye: only the circle. Left eye: unchanged (geometry plus its block).

steps.title: SHOW for the left eye only
steps.look_for: Left eye: only the border. Right eye: still only the circle.

steps.title: SHOW for both eyes
steps.look_for: Both eyes show the geometry scene again (border, circle, line, box at its slid position).

steps.title: Canvas checksum: SHOW for both eyes
steps.look_for: Nothing changes. The right canvas matches the emulator after the three SHOWs.

steps.title: Status after the scenes
steps.look_for: Record heap_free with the retained scene resident and gate_skips (stock frames held off).

steps.title: Brightness low
steps.look_for: Both eyes dim clearly.

steps.title: Brightness restore
steps.look_for: Both eyes return to the level step 3 reported. The payload is 04, this unit's level on 2026-11-10; if step 3 reported a different panel_brightness, send that instead. Not persisted: a reboot or a stock brightness change sets the user level again.

steps.title: Release the display
steps.look_for: The stock UI repaints on both eyes within about a second; nothing from the scene remains.

steps.title: Status after release
steps.look_for: heap_free is back near the step 2 value; gate_skips stays as it was from here on.

steps.title: Canvas checksum after release
steps.look_for: Not owned: the stock screen is back and the canvas is stock's again.
